review: AI review of both crop sheets (92 proposals) and all 22 training frames with approved-anchor boxes. Low-IoU views include oversized person/balloon or room/balloon crops, body fragments and clothing grazing annotated boxes. Exact previously reviewed negatives include faces/hands, fabric, bench, kitchen-container printing and a red store sign. Continuous IoU is visible annotated-box quality, not class probability; clipped edge balloons remain clipped targets. No newly inferred negatives from missing annotations. Not human-certified.
scope: Training-only quality regression; incomplete public annotations, correlated views, not independent qualification
